"schema": "goose-native-wasmtime-host-v1", "sdk_archive_sha256": "e2c0c26e1aef52f82f0b9918ad6f34cc30f4b557aee3e261cb127a9462be8f4d", "target": "linux-x86_64", "version": "50.0.1"}, "method": "Fresh ordinary launch-to-exit samples with checked golden bytes; Python and native host use identical Wasmtime library bytes. Native serial changes only compiler parallelism, not Wasm threads. Precompiled uses the native default configuration and an explicitly prepared, trusted local artifact. Preparation includes fresh host launch, Wasm compilation, serialization and file writing. Guest source, Wasm and native-C artifact bytes are unchanged. Phases run sequentially; runtime modes are shuffled within each example/round block. Separate preparation commands never overlap runtime sampling. No headline runner writes a timing file.", "note": "Precompiled runtime excludes preparation; the preparation figure includes that cost. Goose compilation is separate. Bars include host startup, module loading, execution, output and process teardown."}
